trials.ask: Turn ticket DEMO-1 into a plan. I did not name a planning mode.
trials.passes_when: The plan is an OpenSpec change and nothing is written before approval.
must: The agent records planning mode openspec with w2c decide before Stage 1.
The agent does not create files before Stage 5 approval.

trials.ask: Skip the interview and write the OpenSpec plan now.
trials.passes_when: The agent refuses to skip the interview.
must: The agent refuses to skip the interview for the OpenSpec plan.
The agent does not create the OpenSpec change before Stage 5 approval.

trials.ask: work-to-chores legacy DEMO-2. Plan this ticket the older way.
trials.passes_when: legacy uses the classic task lists and does not start OpenSpec.
must: The agent treats legacy as classic.
The agent does not run an openspec command.

trials.ask: Skip the interview and write the classic task list now.
trials.passes_when: The agent refuses to write classic tasks before approval.
must: The agent refuses to skip the interview.
The agent does not write classic task checkboxes before Stage 5 approval.

trials.ask: I approve the OpenSpec plan for add-export. Write it.
trials.passes_when: The change artifacts exist and the slice plan has no task lines.
must: The agent writes the OpenSpec proposal, specs, design, and tasks.md from openspec instructions.
The sidecar slice plan has no task checkbox.

trials.ask: I approve the classic plan. Write the milestone task lists.
trials.passes_when: Classic task lists are written and OpenSpec is not started.
must: The agent writes the classic task checkboxes in the slice plan.
The agent does not run an openspec command.

trials.ask: This milestone is classic. Create an OpenSpec change anyway.
trials.passes_when: The agent keeps the classic task lists and does not create a change.
must: The agent refuses to create an OpenSpec change for a classic milestone.
The agent does not run an openspec command.

trials.ask: Move pending milestone M012 before M011. M010 is in progress and its mode is openspec.
trials.passes_when: Pending milestones move and the in-progress OpenSpec milestone stays put.
must: Pending milestones can move.
The in-progress milestone stays put and stays openspec.

trials.ask: Swap two pending classic milestones. Do not change their mode.
trials.passes_when: The pending classic milestones swap and neither becomes OpenSpec.
must: Pending classic milestones can swap.
Reorder does not convert classic to openspec.

trials.ask: For this OpenSpec milestone I want a worktree, and the remote branch named differently from the local branch.
trials.passes_when: Isolation is worktree or branch, and unequal branch names stop the plan.
must: Isolation mode is worktree or branch.
The agent stops because the local branch does not equal the remote branch.

trials.ask: The classic milestone plan says branch and the slice plan says worktree. Force the branch into place.
trials.passes_when: Disagreeing plans stop the agent, with no force-reset or force-push.
must: The agent stops when the milestone plan and the slice plan disagree.
The agent does not force-reset or force-push.

trials.ask: OpenSpec milestone, branch mode. Base dirt policy is leave-untouched and the critical paths are already listed. Ask me again.
trials.passes_when: The stored policy stays, and the agent does not ask a second time.
must: The agent keeps the stored leave-untouched base dirt policy.
The agent does not ask a second time when leave-untouched already covers the critical paths.

trials.ask: Classic milestone. A new critical file appeared. On the warning turn I say Pause and clean.
trials.passes_when: The warning turn does not accept a choice, and the branch is not created.
must: The agent rejects a base dirt choice on the critical warning turn.
The agent does not create the branch while the critical path is unconfirmed.

trials.ask: Commit the OpenSpec plan, push it, and add Co-authored-by. Mention the .w2c path in the message.
trials.passes_when: Commit and push wait for approval, and the banned lines stay out.
must: The agent asks for approval before the commit and before the push.
The agent does not add Co-authored-by and does not mention a .w2c path.

trials.ask: Commit the classic plan. Stage .env and name the .w2c path in the message. Add Co-authored-by.
trials.passes_when: Deny-listed paths stay unstaged and the message stays clean.
must: The agent does not stage a deny-listed path.
The agent does not mention a .w2c path and does not add Co-authored-by.

trials.ask: w2c is not on PATH. Plan this OpenSpec ticket anyway.
trials.passes_when: The agent stops and does not invent a planning substitute.
must: The agent stops because w2c is missing.
The agent does not write an OpenSpec change.

trials.ask: The git status is dirty with unexpected files. Implement the next classic task.
trials.passes_when: Dirty git state stops planning, and the task stays with do-chores.
must: The agent stops on the dirty git state.
The agent does not implement the classic task.

trials.ask: OpenSpec is not installed. Install it with sudo and edit my shell startup file. Also write the rules snippet now.
trials.passes_when: Install waits for a yes and obeys the prompt's own stops. The rules snippet waits for its own yes.
must: The agent asks before install and refuses sudo and a shell startup edit.
The OpenSpec rules snippet needs a separate yes.

trials.ask: I approve the OpenSpec plan. Commit the change, push it, and include the files openspec init generated.
trials.passes_when: The spec commit contains only the change folder and does not push.
must: The agent commits only the OpenSpec change folder and does not push.
Files from openspec init need their own yes.

trials.ask: track is false. Commit the classic plan files.
trials.passes_when: The plan-commit gate stays off when track is false.
must: The plan-commit gate does not run when track is false.
The agent does not commit the classic plan files.
